title: Integrative Expression, Survival Analysis and Cellular miR-2909 Molecular Interplay in MRN Complex Check Point Sensor Genes (MRN-CSG) Involved in Breast Cancer.
authors: Singh, Jitender; Sangwan, Namrata; Chauhan, Arushi; Avti, Pramod K
one_liner_zh: 该文研究乳腺癌中miR-2909与MRN复合物DNA修复基因mRNA的分子杂交及与argonaute蛋白的对接，虽涉及蛋白-核酸互作和分子对接，但对象为miRNA-mRNA而非TF-DNA，且方法以实验和简单对接为主，与课题核心关联有限。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Breast cancer, an emerging global challenge, is evidenced by recent studies of miRNAs involvement in DNA repair gene variants (MRE11, RAD50, and NBN as checkpoint sensor genes (CSG) - MRN-CSG). The identification of various mutations in MRN-CSG and their interactions with miRNAs is still not understood. The emerging studies of miR-2909 involvement in other cancers led us to explore its role as molecular mechanistic marker in breast cancer. MATERIALS AND METHODS: The genomic and proteomic data of MRN-CSG of breast cancer patients (8426 samples) was evaluated to identify the mutation types linked with the patient's survival rate. Additionally, molecular, 3D-structural and functional analysis was performed to identify miR-2909 as regulator of MRN-CSG. RESULTS: The genomic and proteomic data analysis shows genetic alterations with majority of missense mutations [RAD50 (0.7%), MRE11 (1.5%), and NBN (11%)], though with highest MRE11 mRNA expression in invasive ductal breast carcinoma as compared to other breast cancer types. The Kaplan-Meier survival curves suggest higher survival rate for unaltered groups as compared to the altered group. Network analysis and disease association of miR-2909 and MRN-CSG shows strong interactions with other partners. The molecular hybridization between miR-2909-RAD50 and miR-2909-MRE11 complexes showed thermodynamically stable structures. Further, argonaute protein, involved in RNA silencing, docking studies with miR-MRE11-mRNA and miR-RAD50-mRNA hybridized complexes showed strong binding affinity. CONCLUSION: The results suggest that miR-2909 forms strong thermodynamically stable molecular hybridized complexes with MRE11 and RAD50 mRNAs which further strongly interacts with argonaute protein to show potential molecular mechanistic role in breast cancer.
abstract_zh: 背景：乳腺癌是一个新兴的全球性挑战，近期关于miRNA参与DNA修复基因变异（MRE11、RAD50和NBN作为检查点传感器基因（CSG）- MRN-CSG）的研究已证实这一点。MRN-CSG中各种突变及其与miRNA的相互作用仍未被理解。miR-2909在其他癌症中参与的新兴研究促使我们探索其在乳腺癌中作为分子机制标志物的作用。材料与方法：评估了乳腺癌患者（8426个样本）MRN-CSG的基因组和蛋白质组数据，以识别与患者生存率相关的突变类型。此外，进行了分子、三维结构和功能分析，以确定miR-2909作为MRN-CSG的调节因子。结果：基因组和蛋白质组数据分析显示，遗传改变以错义突变为主 [RAD50 (0.7%)、MRE11 (1.5%) 和 NBN (11%)]，但在浸润性导管乳腺癌中，与其他乳腺癌类型相比，MRE11 mRNA表达最高。Kaplan-Meier生存曲线表明，未改变组的生存率高于改变组。miR-2909和MRN-CSG的网络分析和疾病关联显示与其他伙伴存在强相互作用。miR-2909-RAD50和miR-2909-MRE11复合物之间的分子杂交显示出热力学稳定的结构。此外，参与RNA沉默的argonaute蛋白与miR-MRE11-mRNA和miR-RAD50-mRNA杂交复合物的对接研究显示出强结合亲和力。结论：结果表明，miR-2909与MRE11和RAD50 mRNA形成强热力学稳定的分子杂交复合物，这些复合物进一步与argonaute蛋白强相互作用，在乳腺癌中显示出潜在的分子机制作用。
